mapper.sql: qn.ID, qn.create_user_id, qn.create_user_name, qn.create_time, qn.update_user_id, qn.update_user_name, qn.update_time, qn.VERSION, qn.is_deleted, qn.approve_status, qn.approve_time, qn.approve_user_id, qn.approve_user_name, qn.code, qn.qc_warehouse_id, qn.putaway_warehouse_id, qn.qc_type, qn.qc_status, qn.remark
mapper.select: select approve_status, count(id) from qc_notice where is_deleted = false group by approve_status

SELECT qn.ID AS id, qn.code AS code, qn.qc_type AS qcType, qn.qc_status AS qcStatus, qn.qc_warehouse_id AS qcWarehouseId, qnd.id AS detailId, qnd.sku_id AS skuId, qnd.sku_no AS skuNo, qnd.product_name AS productName, qnd.qc_notice_qty AS qcNoticeQty, qnd.qc_qty AS qcQty, qnd.qc_diff_qty AS qcDiffQty, qnd.qc_good_qty AS qcGoodQty, qnd.qc_bad_qty AS qcBadQty, qnd.putaway_qty AS putawayQty, qnd.bad_desc AS badDesc, qnd.qc_problem_dict AS qcProblemDict, qnd.qc_date AS qcDate FROM qc_notice AS qn LEFT JOIN qc_notice_detail AS qnd ON qn.ID = qnd.main_id WHERE qn.is_deleted = FALSE AND qn.approve_status = 'approve' AND qnd.is_deleted = FALSE AND qnd.qc_status = 'wait' AND qn.code = #{code} ORDER BY qn.code
